client.ambiguousOutbox: exact retry only, never rebuild or partially ACK
client.capabilityTransition: owner-scoped; missing/downgrade clears cache; first acceptance forces full refresh
client.guest: normal owner claim includes hints; no STANDARD record mutation
client.legacyProjectionPredicate: current and acknowledged baseline set notes both empty; strip empty set note fields
client.unsupported: preserve Room, baseline and pending bytes; never infer deletion from hidden kind

exercise_hint.owner: authenticated owner only, including hints for STANDARD exercises

payload.text: nonblank trimmed string max2000 Unicode codepoints

exercise_hint.referencePolicy: new or changed nondeleted hint requires own or public live exercise; existing hint is retained when referenced exercise is later removed; tombstone allowed

workout.existingWorkoutNote: legacy string max10000 preserved; new editor max2000 Unicode codepoints
workout.incapableRead: strip only set note across all read surfaces before cursor construction
workout.incapableWrite: reject upsert or tombstone discarding stored nonempty set note before ledger/revision
